explanation: In US business culture, punctuality signals respect and professionalism, and arriving late to a meeting without notice is widely seen as unprofessional and inconsiderate of others' time. A few minutes' grace is usually tolerated if you communicate proactively, but showing up late repeatedly or without warning damages your credibility.
local_tip: Aim to arrive a few minutes early, and if you're running late, message the organizer as soon as you know, with an updated arrival time.

also_check.note: Punctuality is taken very seriously; arriving even a minute late is seen as disrespectful and poorly organized.
In cities like Sao Paulo and Rio, meetings often start 10-15 minutes late by custom, though visitors should still aim to arrive on time.
Traffic and flexible scheduling mean meetings may start late, but arriving on time is still appreciated and expected of visitors.
